For all the people who were hating on this name. For all the tourists who got in, made a quick buck, and got off at the first sight of trouble.

THANK YOU!

The real risk to watch is November 8 – when the remaining 43.9M shares become eligible. I’m planning for that, not this Monday.

I was late to this name, but now my average is below 30.

LFG!!! See you at +40 ⚡️
